item.title: Glam Archive: Vintage Designer Clothing in Bangkok — Novalone Studios
item.description: Glam Archive is a one-of-a-kind designer vintage clothing collection in Bangkok, handpicked by Nic, the 26-year-old founder who’s turned his love of fashion and music into a brand and business.

item.title: CHUN: Painting with Threads — Novalone Studios
item.description: Chun is a Vietnamese artist based in Vienna who makes incredibly unique artworks using large industrial-grade embroidery machines. He describes his art as playful and childlike.
